name: compute_balanced_ration
description: MANDATORY for final ration advice. Ask farmer price per kilogram for each feed first. Include price_rs in feeds_json ONLY for prices the farmer gave — LP uses those exactly. Omit price_rs when farmer said pata nahi or did not answer — library rate used automatically. Returns kilogram/day and total daily cost.

lang.description: Language code: hi, en, gu, mr, etc.

weight_kg.description: Body weight in kg, estimate if unknown

calvings.description: Number of calvings / times bachha hua

in_milk.description: True if animal is giving milk now

feeds_json.description: JSON array of feeds farmer uses. Ask price for each feed. Include price_rs ONLY when farmer told you the price (LP uses it exactly). Omit price_rs when pata nahi or no answer — library rate used. Example: [{"name":"gehu bhusa","qty_kg":5,"price_rs":4},{"name":"sarson khali","qty_kg":2}]

neighborhood_feeds_json.description: Second call: local feeds. Ask price for each; include price_rs only if farmer told you, else omit for library rate.

local_feed_names.description: Easier alternative on second call: comma-separated local feed names the farmer said, e.g. hybrid napier grass
